$schema_note: Schema (informal): { components: Component[], flows: Flow[] }. Component = { id, name, summary, category, kind, status, position:{col,row}, source? }. Flow = { id, name, summary, status, tags?, steps: Step[] }. Step = { from, to, label, note?, kind? } where kind ∈ 'request'|'response'|'internal'|'async'|'persist'|'external'. status ∈ 'active'|'partial'|'speculative'|'legacy'|'unknown'. Categories drive column placement; (col,row) gives a stable layout in the explorer. Flow steps MUST only reference existing component ids — see docs/architecture/README.md for the verification commands.

components.name: sera-gateway

components.name: kill_switch

components.name: hitl_gateway

components.name: byoh_registration
components.summary: BYOH handshake (sera-w2dh). register_harness reconciles harness vs gateway tool catalog and returns name_map + suppressed_internals. No HTTP surface yet — invoked via library seam.

components.name: byoh_dispatch_interceptor
components.summary: Production transport decorator (PR #1254). Applies ByohCatalogRegistry::prepare_outbound_call to every Stdio ToolCallBegin event; rewrites the harness's emitted tool name to the gateway canonical name.

components.name: openai_compat + llm_proxy
components.summary: /v1/chat/completions, /v1/messages, /v1/models legacy passthrough drivers for OpenAI- and Anthropic-shaped clients (route_inference_proxy is the canonical Phase-3 implementation).

components.name: inference_proxy (route)

components.name: RuntimeChildSupervisor
components.summary: Default dispatch mode (SERA_DISPATCH_MODE=runtime). Spawns one `sera-runtime --ndjson --no-health` child per agent, owns its stdin/stdout, restarts on exit. Implements AgentTurnTransport.

components.name: EmbeddedRuntimeTransport
components.summary: sera-ve9x. Alternative dispatch (SERA_DISPATCH_MODE=embedded). Implements AgentTurnTransport against an in-process DefaultRuntime — no child process. Staging path for pending steer items lives here.

components.name: HeaderMailCorrelator
components.summary: sera-uwk0 Design B mail-gate ingress correlator: RFC 5322 headers + SERA-issued nonce fallback. Backs /api/mail/inbound.

components.name: external_agent_registry
components.summary: Pattern-B sessions registry (sera-pcvp). Validates delegated_by, enforces declared egress allow-list, mints PrincipalRef via Principal::external_agent_with_delegator.

components.name: policy_resolution + capability_enforcement
components.summary: Resolves the PolicyResolver chain and enforces CapabilityRegistry per request/tool call. Produces the `[sera-policy] tool '…' denied …` audit shape regardless of transport.

components.name: scheduler
components.summary: Workflow scheduler (sera-kgi8). TICK_INTERVAL loop snapshots pending workflow tasks and resolves Timer / Mail / GhRun / GhPr / Change / Human gates each tick. Other gate types are no-op until follow-up beads.

components.name: github_poller

flows.name: Chat turn (HTTP)
flows.summary: User sends a message via POST /api/chat. Gateway authenticates, enqueues on the session lane, dispatches into a per-agent runtime (runtime mode: NDJSON child via RuntimeChildSupervisor; embedded mode: in-process DefaultRuntime). Runtime drives the reasoning loop and streams completion deltas back as SSE. Transcript persists to sera-db.

steps.label: POST /api/chat {message, agent?, stream?}
steps.note: Bearer auth header required (dev key: sera_bootstrap_dev_123). No /v1/ prefix; sessions are server-managed.

steps.label: kill_switch_gate middleware
steps.note: 503 if globally armed. Wraps every /api/* route.

steps.label: resolve session, enqueue on lane
steps.note: Lane queue prevents concurrent turn wedge; if lane busy → 429 queued.

steps.label: spawn or reuse runtime child for agent
steps.note: Default SERA_DISPATCH_MODE=runtime spawns `sera-runtime --ndjson --no-health` and keeps it warm across turns.

steps.label: send_turn NDJSON Submission frame
steps.note: Wrapped in tokio::time::timeout(SERA_TURN_TIMEOUT_SECS, default 120s) to avoid lane wedge.

steps.label: decode HandshakeFrame on first send, then Submissions
four-method loop: observe / think / act / react
transcript_persist (turn rows)
steps.note: ContentBlock transcript stored for session replay; audit row via sera-telemetry.

flows.name: Cancel turn
flows.summary: Operator or client cancels an in-flight turn. Gateway flips the session's client_cancelled flag (sera-mplr); the active runtime aborts the turn and lane returns to idle.

steps.label: cancel_http_chat_session(session_id)
steps.note: Sets client_cancelled=true; the in-flight chat_handler returns the cancellation error path.

steps.label: send cancel signal to active child
abort current turn at next tool boundary

flows.name: Dispatch mode: runtime (Stdio child)
flows.summary: Default dispatch mode. SERA_DISPATCH_MODE=runtime (or unset). RuntimeChildSupervisor spawns one `sera-runtime --ndjson --no-health` child per agent, restarts it on exit, and routes Submissions/Events as the AgentTurnTransport implementor.

steps.label: spawn `sera-runtime --ndjson --no-health` child
steps.note: PATH-resolved via SERA_RUNTIME_BIN or built-in default.

steps.label: child exit / panic
steps.note: Supervisor restarts the child on the next turn boundary; one panic cannot wedge the agent.

flows.name: Dispatch mode: embedded (in-process)
flows.summary: Alternative dispatch (sera-ve9x): SERA_DISPATCH_MODE=embedded. EmbeddedRuntimeTransport implements AgentTurnTransport directly against an in-process DefaultRuntime; no child process. Steer items are staged in a Mutex<Vec<Value>> and drained into the next turn's TurnContext.metadata['pending_steer'].

flows.name: HITL approval round-trip
flows.summary: Runtime hits a tool that requires human approval. tool_hooks pauses, sera-hitl persists a request, operator approves via /api/hitl/requests/{id}/approve, runtime resumes the tool call.

steps.label: enqueue ApprovalRequest
steps.note: Includes tool name, args summary, risk class.

steps.label: execute sandboxed tool
steps.note: Sandbox + SSRF guards from sera-tools; egress filtered via ext-squid.

flows.name: HITL escalation
flows.summary: Operator rejects or escalates a HITL ticket up the chain. sera-hitl walks the configured ApprovalRouting chain until a higher-tier operator approves or the request times out.

steps.label: advance ApprovalRouting chain
steps.note: Walks escalation tiers; emits audit row per hop.

steps.label: persist new tier on hitl_request row

flows.name: Workflow task run
flows.summary: Client schedules a workflow task. sera-workflow persists it, the gateway scheduler tick resolves gates and activates ready tasks, sera-runtime executes one or more turns, results land back in the workflow store.

steps.label: TICK: list_pending + ready_tasks_with_context(now)
steps.note: Timer / Mail / GhRun / GhPr / Change / Human gates resolved on each tick (default 1s).

steps.label: activate task: drive a turn with payload

flows.name: Workflow resume (Human gate)
flows.summary: A workflow task is parked on a Human gate. Operator resumes it via /api/workflow/tasks/{id}/resume, which feeds a HumanGateStore lookup that the scheduler tick consults.

steps.label: next TICK observes resolved gate, activates task

flows.name: Workflow scheduler tick
flows.summary: Background tokio loop in the gateway. Every TICK_INTERVAL, snapshot stores (GhRun, GhPr, Change, HumanGate, Mail) → call ready_tasks_with_context → mark resolved tasks ready. Logs a tracing event per resolution.

steps.label: ready_tasks_with_context(snapshot, now)
steps.note: Pure function — separates resolution from store mutation.

flows.name: GitHub poller tick (gh-api feature)
flows.summary: Cargo feature `gh-api` (sera-ai4w). Background loop pulls GhPr / GhRun state from GitHub for IDs already registered in the gateway stores. Pull-only (never inserts new IDs); best-effort (transient failures leave entries untouched).

steps.label: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{n}, /actions/runs/{id}
steps.note: PAT auth via SERA_GH_TOKEN. No octocrab — uses workspace reqwest.

flows.name: BYOH agent dispatch (production path)
flows.summary: Bring Your Own Harness: gateway detects BYOH agent in the chat request and routes the turn to sera-byoh-agent over Stdio instead of the default runtime. Lands via sera-plcv PR #1252 (probe) and PR #1254 (interceptor).

steps.label: spawn / select BYOH runtime over Stdio
steps.note: ByohInterceptingTransport wraps the Stdio transport; byoh_catalog tracks registered BYOH runtimes.

steps.label: rewritten Events (canonical tool names)
steps.note: See byoh-tool-intercept flow for the rewrite contract.

flows.name: BYOH catalog registration handshake (sera-w2dh)
flows.summary: BYOH harness boot-time handshake. Harness submits its tool catalog; gateway reconciles vs the canonical gateway catalog: dedupe, suppress collisions in favour of gateway tools, produce a name_map. Harness installs the result locally. No HTTP route yet — invoked via library seam.

steps.label: register_harness(harness_id, HarnessCatalog)
steps.note: Today: library seam only. HTTP/op surface is a follow-up bead.

steps.label: reconcile(GatewayToolDecl[], HarnessToolDecl[])
steps.note: Policy: duplicates within either catalog rejected; collisions resolve in favour of the gateway implementation.

flows.name: BYOH tool-call interception (PR #1254)
flows.summary: When a registered BYOH harness emits a ToolCallBegin event whose tool name is in suppressed_internals, ByohInterceptingTransport rewrites the `tool` field to the canonical gateway name before the event reaches any consumer. Pattern A only.

steps.label: internal tool invocation (harness-local name, e.g. Hermes 'Read')
prepare_outbound_call(harness_id, 'Read')
steps.note: OutboundCallDecision::SuppressAndForward { canonical: 'read_file' } if registry says so.

flows.name: Tool call end-to-end (sandboxed)
flows.summary: Inside a turn, the model emits a tool_call. Runtime applies policy + capability checks, runs SsrfValidator / BashAstChecker, dispatches via SandboxProvider into a Docker sandbox, with egress filtered by Squid. Kill-switch halts dispatch if armed.

steps.label: resolve PolicyResolver chain
steps.note: If denied, audit row '[sera-policy] tool ... denied' is emitted regardless of transport.

steps.label: consult global kill switch
steps.note: If armed, deny dispatch and emit Interruption.

flows.name: AG-UI event stream
flows.summary: Front-end / client opens an AG-UI SSE stream; sera-agui forwards the 17-event protocol from runtime emissions and client-side emits.

steps.label: emit AG-UI events (17 types)
steps.note: Run lifecycle, text deltas, tool calls, state, errors.

flows.name: Plugin call (gRPC)
flows.summary: Client invokes a registered plugin by id. sera-plugins dispatches via gRPC SDK with a circuit breaker; result returns to the caller. Hot-reload available via /api/plugins/hot-reload.

steps.label: gRPC out to plugin sidecar container
steps.note: Plugin processes typically run as sidecar containers; SDK lives in sera-plugins.

flows.name: Plugin hot-reload
flows.summary: Operator hot-reloads a plugin definition via /api/plugins/hot-reload. Registry swaps the descriptor without dropping in-flight gRPC calls served by the previous descriptor.

flows.name: Evolution proposal apply
flows.summary: Self-evolution: shadow sessions in sera-meta surface candidate rule changes. Operator approves a proposal, supplies an operator key, then applies — sera-meta persists and hot-applies the policy to running runtimes.

flows.name: Constitutional gate (hook chain)
flows.summary: Every turn runs through the HookRegistry's ConstitutionalGateHook (sera-0yh3). The hook consults the current ConstitutionalRegistry; in local dev SERA_ALLOW_MISSING_CONSTITUTIONAL_GATE=1 permits a missing gate (sera-local default).

steps.label: HookResult — deny aborts the turn; review routes to HITL

flows.name: Mail-to-workflow
flows.summary: Inbound mail server posts MIME to /api/mail/inbound. HeaderMailCorrelator normalises and correlates (RFC 5322 headers + SERA-issued nonce fallback), then sera-mail records the envelope and the gateway-scheduler's Mail-gate snapshot picks it up.

steps.label: parse + correlate (header + nonce fallback)
steps.note: sera-uwk0 Design B: RFC 5322 In-Reply-To/Message-Id + SERA-issued nonce when headers absent.

flows.name: Mail deliver (test injector)
flows.summary: /api/workflow/mail/deliver lets tests inject mail events without touching real SMTP. The gateway accepts a synthetic envelope and routes it through sera-mail just like /api/mail/inbound would.

steps.label: TICK observes new envelope, resolves Mail gate

flows.name: OpenAI / Anthropic agent-compat
flows.summary: OpenAI- or Anthropic-shaped clients drive a SERA agent turn via /v1/chat/completions or /v1/messages (legacy openai_compat + llm_proxy code path). Translates request into the internal turn and shapes the response back. Distinct from the inference-proxy flow which is a pure provider passthrough.

steps.label: drive turn via embedded transport
steps.note: openai_compat.rs vs llm_proxy.rs split: openai_compat drives an agent turn; llm_proxy is a pure provider passthrough (see inference-proxy-passthrough).

flows.name: Inference proxy passthrough (sera-7ivj)
flows.summary: /v1/chat/completions and /v1/messages handled by route_inference_proxy. Pure provider passthrough — no agent turn. Adds audit + budget seams + capability gating. Allows host-side tooling to call SERA as a provider while preserving audit.

flows.name: A2A peer exchange
flows.summary: A remote A2A-compliant agent hands an envelope to SERA via /api/a2a/accept; sera-a2a validates and routes to the addressed local agent. Reverse direction posts to peers via /api/a2a/send.

flows.name: Skill execution
flows.summary: Runtime resolves a SkillRef (semver), loads its steps from sera-skills, and runs them through tool_hooks. Bash-style steps go through the sandbox.

steps.label: BashAstChecker / SsrfValidator
steps.note: Security primitives mandatory before sandbox dispatch.

flows.name: Memory write (episodic + semantic)
flows.summary: End of turn, context_engine decides what to persist. Default local backend is SqliteMemoryStore (sera-vzce: FTS5 + sqlite-vec + RRF). Enterprise/plugin paths route through PgVectorStore (on Postgres) or HindsightStore (Docker).

steps.label: default backend (zero-infra tier)
steps.note: Selection driven by SERA_MEMORY_BACKEND + DATABASE_URL.

steps.label: HTTP put → operation poll
steps.note: Hindsight runs as a sidecar Docker container; no per-memory delete; no bulk eviction.

flows.name: Memory search tool (Tier-2 recall)
flows.summary: LLM calls the memory_search tool. Runtime embeds the query, runs SemanticMemoryStore::query against the active backend, dedupes against ContextEnricher's active_recall_ids, and returns a MemorySearchToolResult.

steps.label: update last_accessed_at per hit
steps.note: Pure access-tracking signal; not a material state change.

flows.name: Kill switch arm (admin)
flows.summary: Operator arms the global kill switch. Gateway flips the middleware flag; every subsequent /api/* request 503s and runtimes are signalled to kill their current turns for rollback. Status visible via /admin/killswitch/status.

flows.name: Admin policy reload
flows.summary: Operator reloads constitutional policies from the on-disk capability-policies/ directory without restarting the gateway. ConstitutionalRegistry RwLock<Arc<…>> swap + hot-apply to runtimes.

flows.name: Admin policy validate (dry-run)
flows.summary: Operator validates a candidate policy bundle without applying it. Useful in CI / pre-flight before evolution-apply.

flows.name: Discord-driven chat turn
flows.summary: A Discord user posts in a channel; gateway-discord maps channel → session and drives a turn just like the HTTP chat path. Reply is posted back to the channel.

flows.name: MCP tool call
flows.summary: An external MCP-compliant client connects to sera-mcp and invokes a SERA-exposed tool. sera-mcp bridges to runtime tool_hooks; tool result is mapped back to MCP.

flows.name: Subagent spawn (sera-vuss)
flows.summary: Caller spawns a subagent under a session via POST /api/sessions/{id}/subagents. route_subagents drives runtime-subagent-mgr to create a child task, which runs as its own turn loop.

flows.name: Intercom pub/sub (sera-nd4v)
flows.summary: In-process intercom broker. POST /api/intercom/publish broadcasts to topic subscribers; GET /api/intercom/subscribe/{topic} streams SSE. Tier-1 default; Centrifugo remains available as a transport for enterprise multi-pod setups.

steps.label: publish into broadcast channel
steps.note: DEFAULT_TOPIC_CAPACITY=256; beyond that the channel is lossy.

flows.name: Centrifugo publish (enterprise)
flows.summary: Optional path used by multi-pod deployments. sera-telemetry's Centrifugo adapter publishes audit / intercom messages to an external Centrifugo server. Local setups must not require this.

steps.label: POST publish (HTTP API)
steps.note: Enabled only when Centrifugo URL + key are configured.

flows.name: Pattern-B submission (external agent)
flows.summary: External agent (clawhip Claude pane, OMC orchestrator pane, A2A/ACP agent) registers and drives turns via POST /api/submissions / /api/sq. external_agent_registry validates delegated_by, mints PrincipalRef, enforces declared egress allow-list. Pattern B does not share a tool catalog with the gateway.

steps.label: validate delegated_by + register session
steps.note: Refuses unknown / wrong-kind delegators; refuses duplicate session_key.

flows.name: Operator task (Bero closeout)
flows.summary: POST /api/operator/tasks. Privileged path for operator-driven tasks; classify_operator_task_turn translates a MvsTurnResult into a Bero-style status card (OperatorTaskCloseout).

flows.name: Runtime signal emission
flows.summary: During a turn, runtime emits Signals (Blocked / Review / Continue / Refused / etc) via SignalEmitter. Signals land in sera-db's SignalStore inbox; HITL routes / future signals/push subscribers can pick them up.

steps.label: SignalStore.put(agent_id, signal)
steps.note: Blocked / Review signals always reach HITL regardless of SignalTarget.

flows.name: Signal push (NDJSON) — library only
flows.summary: POST /api/signals/push accepts an NDJSON stream of SignalPushFrame, persists each into the addressed agent's inbox. Handler implemented in sera-gateway/signals.rs but the route is not wired into bin/sera.rs's Router today — surface is partial.

steps.label: POST /api/signals/push  (NDJSON SignalPushFrame[])
steps.note: Route exists at library level (push_signals_handler) but is not mounted in bin/sera.rs's Router as of 2026-05-13.

flows.name: Circle party mode
flows.summary: POST /api/circles/{id}/party — circle-scoped party mode (sera-8d1.2-follow). Starts a multi-agent activity within a circle. Constitution GET/PUT for circles is currently a TODO in bin/sera.rs.

flows.name: Invite new user (speculative)
flows.summary: There is no concrete invite endpoint in the active Rust gateway today — production auth uses API-key bootstrap + JWT / OIDC. This flow is a sketch of what a SERA-native invite would touch, marked speculative so it isn't mistaken for shipped behaviour.

steps.label: mint API key + create user record

flows.name: Local dev bring-up (scripts/sera-local)
flows.summary: Ops orientation flow. scripts/sera-local builds gateway+runtime (cargo build) and starts the gateway against a host LM Studio on :1234. No Docker required. Sets SERA_ALLOW_MISSING_CONSTITUTIONAL_GATE=1 by default.

steps.label: cargo build -p sera-gateway -p sera-runtime
steps.note: First run only.

flows.name: Docker bring-up (rust/docker-compose.sera.yml)
flows.summary: Boots gateway + runtime inside Docker. Bridge networking (NEVER network_mode: host on WSL2). Published ports on both 0.0.0.0 and [::] so Windows 11's IPv6-first localhost resolves. LM Studio reached via host.docker.internal.

steps.label: host.docker.internal:1234/v1/models probe
steps.note: extra_hosts: host.docker.internal:host-gateway is required for non-Docker-Desktop hosts.

flows.name: Cargo validation loop (dev)
flows.summary: Standard inner dev loop in rust/. `cargo check --workspace` (~1-3s incremental), `cargo test --workspace`, `cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings`. sccache via RUSTC_WRAPPER keeps deps warm.

steps.label: cargo check --workspace
steps.note: Fastest gate; runs incrementally per crate via sccache.

flows.name: Readiness probe (/api/health/ready)
flows.summary: Distinct from /api/health (liveness). /api/health/ready stays 503 until probe_runtime_ready returns true — protects against the empty-reply race right after `docker restart`. Gate traffic on this, not /api/health.

steps.label: probe_runtime_ready (try_wait+handshake)
steps.note: Returns false until at least one runtime child is responsive.

flows.name: Hindsight memory canary
flows.summary: Pluggable-memory conformance canary. Boot a local hindsight Docker container; sera-memory-hindsight talks to it via HTTP. Used in tests alongside SqliteMemoryStore to keep the SemanticMemoryStore trait honest.

steps.label: HTTP put / recall / operation poll
steps.note: Per-memory delete and bulk eviction are unsupported by the hindsight backend.

flows.name: Context compaction checkpoint
flows.summary: When turn history nears the model's context budget, the compaction module produces a condensed checkpoint. Runtime caps MAX_COMPACTION_CHECKPOINTS_PER_SESSION to bound budget growth (P0-6 M2 gate).

flows.name: Runtime NDJSON handshake (sera-zx5w)
flows.summary: First frame emitted by sera-runtime --ndjson is a canonical HandshakeFrame from sera-types::envelope. Subsequent frames use the canonical Submission / Event envelopes. Wire-compatible with the legacy duplicate types — the canonical envelope was extended, not the other way around.

flows.name: Doom-loop interruption
flows.summary: Self-defence inside the turn loop. After DOOM_LOOP_THRESHOLD=3 consecutive act cycles with no progress, the runtime emits Interruption and short-circuits the turn rather than burn the context budget.

steps.label: increment doom_loop_count on each empty act
emit Signal { Refused, doom_loop }
steps.note: Lands in sera-db SignalStore; HITL escalation possible.

flows.name: Knowledge tool (built-in)
flows.summary: Runtime's `knowledge` built-in tool reads from the local knowledge surface (skill packs + persisted memories + agent manifest pinned facts). Risk level Read.
